elegant-wedding-banquet.title: Elegant Wedding Banquet
elegant-wedding-banquet.text: Thoughtfully prepared menus for ceremonies, receptions, and unforgettable celebrations. Includes Ethiopian and western fusion dishes. Service: Full setup, serving, and cleanup included. Ingredients: Doro Wot (chicken, berbere spice, garlic, ginger, onions), Misir Wot (red lentils, berbere, butter), Gomen (collard greens, garlic, ginger), Injera (teff flour, water, salt), Ethiopian honey, rosemary

reception-dining.title: Reception Dining
reception-dining.text: Served with style for intimate receptions and grand wedding nights. Authentic Doro Wot and habesha favorites alongside international options. Service: Full catering with elegant presentation. Ingredients: Chicken, prime beef, shallots, garlic, ginger, chili peppers, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, fenugreek, coriander, niter kibbeh (spiced butter), Ethiopian mustard

ceremony-feast.title: Ceremony Feast
ceremony-feast.text: A warm menu selection designed for memorable wedding moments. Fusion of Ethiopian and international cuisine tailored to your guests. Service: Custom menu planning available. Ingredients: Lamb, onions, tomatoes, Ethiopian paprika, cumin, turmeric, bay leaves, fresh cilantro, lemon, black cardamom, garlic cloves, Ethiopian honey wine

executive-catering.title: Executive Catering
executive-catering.text: Polished meal service for meetings, team lunches, and company events. Meals delivered branded and on time. Service: Delivery only or full setup available. Ingredients: Tibs (sautéed meat with vegetables), shallots, tomatoes, green peppers, jalapeños, butter, fresh lime juice, salt, black pepper

business-lunch-package.title: Business Lunch Package
business-lunch-package.text: Reliable catering for productive sessions and client-facing occasions. Hot meals delivered in under 30 minutes. Service: Delivery included, setup optional. Ingredients: Split peas (shiro), onions, garlic, ginger, chili peppers, niter kibbeh, Injera, Ethiopian mustard seeds

corporate-gala.title: Corporate Gala
corporate-gala.text: Refined catering for launches, awards nights, and special business events. Full-service with elegant plating and professional staff. Service: Full catering with cleanup. Ingredients: Prime beef, mushrooms, cream sauce, roasted vegetables, Brussels sprouts, herb-roasted potatoes, garlic butter, Madeira wine

seasonal-corporate-dining.title: Seasonal Corporate Dining
seasonal-corporate-dining.text: Balanced, varied menus for recurring team meals and seasonal office gatherings. Ethiopian and international options. Service: Scheduled delivery plans available. Ingredients: Kale, spinach, chickpeas, lentils, Ethiopian cardamom, black cumin, fresh herbs, seasonal vegetables, sunflower oil

birthday-celebration-package.title: Birthday Celebration Package
birthday-celebration-package.text: Fresh dishes and sweet treats made for joyful gatherings. Includes custom cake options. Service: Full catering with setup and cleanup. Ingredients: Chicken, spices, onions, garlic, injera, mixed vegetables, chocolate cake, vanilla frosting, butter, eggs, flour, sugar

kids-party-catering.title: Kids' Party Catering
kids-party-catering.text: Fun, flavorful food that keeps every guest happy. Kid-friendly menus with colorful presentation. Service: Delivery or full setup available. Ingredients: Pasta, mild chicken sauce, vegetables, cheese, fruit platters, juice, child-safe spices, butter, olive oil

sweet-tables-and-desserts.title: Sweet Tables & Desserts
sweet-tables-and-desserts.text: Crowd-pleasing bites and dessert options for birthday celebrations. Cakes, cookies, and custom treats. Service: Delivery or event setup. Ingredients: All-purpose flour, eggs, sugar, butter, vanilla extract, chocolate, berries, cream, honey, nuts, coconut

celebration-desserts.title: Celebration Desserts
celebration-desserts.text: Colorful cakes and treats to finish the party on a high note. Includes anniversaries, graduations, baby showers, and bridal showers. Service: Custom orders welcome. Ingredients: Flour, sugar, eggs, butter, cream cheese frosting, food coloring, fondant, fresh berries, chocolate ganache, vanilla beans

fasting-meal-package.title: Fasting Meal Package
fasting-meal-package.text: Wholesome plant-based dishes prepared for seasonal fasting. Rich in flavor with traditional Ethiopian ingredients. Service: Delivery or full catering setup. Ingredients: Red lentils, split peas, chickpeas, onions, garlic, ginger, Ethiopian spices, injera, collard greens, sunflower oil, salt

seasonal-holiday-catering.title: Seasonal Holiday Catering
seasonal-holiday-catering.text: Balanced fasting-friendly and festive meals for Christmas, Genna, New Year's, Epiphany, and more. Service: Full catering with traditional dining setup available. Ingredients: Beef, lamb, lentils, barley, seasonal vegetables, spices, niter kibbeh, Ethiopian honey wine, fresh herbs, injera

rooftop-cocktail-package.title: Rooftop Cocktail Package
rooftop-cocktail-package.text: Elegant finger foods, canapés, and beverages for cocktail parties and product launches. Professional staff and refined presentation. Service: Full catering with staff included. Ingredients: Smoked salmon, prosciutto, cheese selection, crackers, phyllo dough, herbs, lemon, olive oil, sparkling wine, mixers

fusion-cocktail-menu.title: Fusion Cocktail Menu
fusion-cocktail-menu.text: A curated mix of Ethiopian bites and international appetizers for upscale social events. Custom menu planning available. Service: Setup, serving, and cleanup included. Ingredients: Beef tibs, shallots, Ethiopian spices, injera wraps, cured meats, grapes, olives, herbs, garlic aioli, fresh lime
